description: Find what is on at a named venue: dated events from its local today onwards. Filter by exact event_type if you know it. If not available, check the capabilities venue_profile lists; the venue may not publish this.

city.description: Disambiguate a name by city (call list_cities); ignored for a slug.

cursor.description: Number of items to skip; pass `next_cursor` from the previous page.

event_type.description: Exact event_type spelling from published events.

from_date.description: ISO date; defaults to the venue's own local today, or to today UTC if it publishes no timezone.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

to_date.description: ISO date; omit to_date for everything upcoming (recommended for "coming up").

venue.description: Venue name or slug; call search_venues to discover one.

name: venue_events

outputSchema.description: The Yenta response envelope: a status, the answer in `item` or `items`, and the approved content revision it was read from.

title: Search a venue's events by name
